name: Poirino (Italy)
description: Blue field bearing a red panel with a white Greek cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Poirino within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Poirino, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Poirino arms — yellow cross on white, crowned, within branches
